biotools.summary: FastSAM-3DSlicer is a 3D Slicer extension that integrates 2D and 3D Segment Anything Model (SAM) variants for interactive volumetric medical image segmentation with uncertainty quantification. It provides a streamlined, user-friendly interface with rapid inference times and is publicly available with demonstration videos and source code.
